_readme: Sensor model of the IR on the gimbal for the MHT with sensor model (vf/fusion/sensor_aware_mht.py), used by demo.live --sensor-model config/sensor_model_ir.json with acquisition/ir_scan.py states. The ArUco model (config/sensor_model.json) does not fit the IR: its 88 deg field of view is taken around ONE heading per robot (the beam of its first reading), so a box ranged at another gimbal angle can never be associated and every robot makes duplicates. Here: field of view all around (the gimbal turns to every box), p_D 0.95 for a visible box (the scan aims at every visible box), range noise 2.4 cm (real run, 3 robots), across-beam error from the aim (1.5 deg) and the beam footprint, the report moved one apothem (6.8 cm) along the beam (face -> box centre), no viewing angle (ir_scan sends none), false readings (edge mix, slipped beam) spread over the range.
